text:
emily: Heads-up 1: we have requests to modernize the Node quickstart. current sample uses callbacks and the old `require('redwood')` path. can someone take the lead?

jon: I can. plan: switch to ES modules + async/await and add a tiny TypeScript variant. also fix the fetch usage for Node 18 vs older runtimes.

teo: please also update the Vercel + Netlify deploy instructions. Vercel now needs `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` in project envs and the build step is `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings` (jk, just kidding) 60a but seriously update the env screenshots.

emily: hah. yes update both. and include a one-liner for adding a secret in GitHub Actions. folks keep asking.

jon: snippet I'll add for Node (ESM):

```
import { Client } from 'redwood-sdk'
const client = new Client({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-small', prompt: 'hello' })
console.log(resp.text)
```

I'll add a TypeScript example with the minimal types too.

priya: tiny UX ask: can we show the exact response shape in the quickstart (so users know `resp.text` exists)? a small JSON example helps.

jon: good call. I'll paste a sample response snippet.

doc-bot: PR 456 opened by jon -> https://git.redwood/example/PR-456 (docs/quickstart/node)

max: FYI the markdown renderer in the docs site escapes backticks weirdly in code fences. last time I fixed it by adding an extra newline before the fence. watch out.

jon: noted. I'll run the docs site preview locally.

emily: also please update the starter-app repo's `readme.md` and `package.json` start script. some images in the getting-started page point to the old `docs/static/logo.png` path which moved.

teo: adding a second deploy note: Vercel uses runtime envs but for local dev we should show `.env.local` example. small snippet: `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=sk-...` and ignore the file.

jon: included. GH Actions secret snippet I'll add: 

```
- name: Inject REDWOOD token
  run: echo \"REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN }}\" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```

priya: perfect. can we also add a very short troubleshooting section: common error `401 Unauthorized` -> check token env, build env vs runtime env, and make sure client instantiation uses `token:` not `apiKey:`.

jon: will do. quick compatibility note: older SDK versions accepted `apiKey`. I'll add a migration blurb linking to the SDK changelog.

doc-bot: PR 456 -> CI: failed (lint error in docs markdown). logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/456

jon: fixing lint now (missing trailing newline in TS example). pushing patch.

max: I reviewed the preview and left inline comments about image paths and alt-text.

emily: timeline: aim to merge tomorrow morning. priya can you do final content review after jon's fixes?

priya: yes, I'll review once CI is green. also add a small note for customers using older Node 14 runtimes to require `node-fetch` polyfill.

teo: one last ask: update the quickstart TOC entry so the Node section is explicitly "Node (JavaScript & TypeScript)". new users find it faster.

jon: done in the draft. pushing the lint fix now.

doc-bot: PR 456 -> CI: success. preview deployed at https://docs-preview.redwood/pr-456

priya: looks good overall. a couple wording nits I'll push a tiny editorial commit.

emily: thanks everyone. after merge we'll post a short note in #announcements and add an item to the onboarding checklist for new hires. if anything blocks, ping me. :tada:
